  WHERE (s.contributor_id = public.current_contributor_id())))

constraints.name: gold_labels_canonical_unit
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((property = ANY (ARRAY['soc'::text, 'clay'::text, 'sand'::text, 'silt'::text, 'n'::text])) AND (unit = 'g/kg'::text)) OR ((property = 'ph'::text) AND (unit = 'pH'::text)) OR ((property = 'bd'::text) AND (unit = 'kg/dm3'::text)) OR ((property = 'cec'::text) AND (unit = 'cmol(+)/kg'::text))))

constraints.name: gold_labels_submission_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (submission_id) REFERENCES public.submissions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: photos_camera_metadata_allowlist
constraints.definition: CHECK (((camera_metadata_private IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(camera_metadata_private) = 'object'::text) AND ((camera_metadata_private - ARRAY['make'::text, 'model'::text, 'focal_length_mm'::text, 'exposure_time_s'::text, 'f_number'::text, 'iso'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb))))
